script:
$hermesDir = "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes"
Copy-Item "$hermesDir\hermes-agent\cli-config.yaml.example" "$hermesDir\config.yaml" -Force
"Restored clean config"
$b64 = ""
[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\fix_config.py" -Encoding utf8
python "$env:TEMP\fix_config.py" 2>&1
$env:Path += ";C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\bin"
"=== doctor ==="
hermes doctor 2>&1 | Select-String "model/provider|Could not validate" | Select-Object -First 5
